user.title: Connect to your RustDo Hub
user.description: RustDo's lists become to-do lists here. In RustDo, open Settings › Sync & sharing, turn on Sync my devices if it isn't on yet, and copy the sync key.

data_description.hub: The address RustDo uses, e.g. 192.168.1.20:7979 or https://todo.example.com

reauth_confirm.title: Sync key no longer works
reauth_confirm.description: The hub doesn't know this sync key any more. Copy the current one from RustDo's Settings › Sync & sharing.

error.bad_hub: That doesn't look like a hub address.
error.bad_key: A sync key has 20 letters and digits, like ABCDE-FGHJK-MNPQR-STUVW.
error.unknown_key: The hub doesn't know this sync key. Check it in RustDo's Settings › Sync & sharing.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the hub. Is it running, and can Home Assistant reach this address?

abort.already_configured: These RustDo lists are already set up.
